author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: two rounded weight plates joined by the bar, upright posts from the plates to the floor, and the end-on bench (tapered seat with rounded top corners on two legs) centred between them; mirrored about x=24. Earlier candidates were rejected: a narrow seat top read as a letter A and pinched (internal-spacing review), and 16-tall plates crowded the seat corner (MIC 7.97). The rejected drawing had slanted splayed bench legs and a cramped seat.
omissions: The bar ends protruding beyond the plates are dropped: the plates sit on the keyshape edge and 2-unit stubs would read as nubs.
drawing_plan: Mirrored plates x 6..14 / 34..42, y 6..20; bar y=13; posts x=10/38; seat base x 19..29 at y=35, top y=24; legs to y=42.
lucide_reference: Lucide 'dumbbell': rounded-rectangle plates joined by a straight bar.
